svg.aria-label: Consequence Rail. Recourse-gated execution and settlement receipts for autonomous actions. An action runs only after a bounded remedy is reserved for it, and closes with a signed outcome: settled, compensated or disputed. Shown as a carriage on a closed rail that turns green after it passes the recourse gate.
